# ESP-SDR wire protocol (version 2)

Every frame, in both directions and for stream records, has the same layout
(little endian):

| Field | Size | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| magic | 2 | `E5 D5` |
| type | 1 | message id below |
| seq / tag | 1 | requests: chosen by the host; replies and records echo it |
| length | 4 | payload bytes |
| payload | length | fixed fields below, then variable data where noted |
| crc32 | 4 | IEEE CRC-32 (zlib) over type, seq, length and payload |

Rules:

* Requests marked "followed by" carry variable data after the fixed fields.
* Requests carry at most 64 payload bytes; longer ones are answered with `ERR_BAD_LENGTH`.
* A request with a bad CRC is ignored; the host times out and retries.
* Every request gets exactly one `ACK` or typed reply, except `CAPTURE`, `RING_*`,
  `SPECTRUM` and `IQ_STREAM`, which send data frames and always end with `RUN_DONE`.
* Any byte sent while a stream runs stops it (`STOP` is the polite form).
* Bytes before a magic are skipped, so boot output and noise are harmless.
* A request on a second port while the first holds the lease (5 s after its last
  request, or until `RELEASE`) is answered with `ERR_BUSY`.

Values: rate: rate_80m = 0, rate_40m = 1, rate_16m = 2; format: format_iq32 = 0, format_iq10 = 1, format_iq8 = 2; workers: workers_single = 0, workers_dual_assist = 1, workers_dual = 2;
GPIO state: gpio_float = 0, gpio_low = 1, gpio_high = 2; mode: mode_rx = 0, mode_tx = 1; region: region_ism = 0, region_ham = 1, region_unrestricted = 2.

Errors: err_none = 0, err_unknown_command = 1, err_bad_length = 2, err_bad_argument = 3, err_busy = 4, err_timeout = 5, err_unsupported = 6, err_no_memory = 7, err_hardware = 8, err_wrong_mode = 9.

Run status: run_ok = 0, run_fail_arg = 1, run_fail_late = 2, run_fail_age = 3, run_fail_start = 4, run_fail_end = 5, run_fail_length = 6.

## Requests

| Name | Id | Payload fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET_INFO` | `0x01` | - | Firmware identity and limits; answered with INFO. |
| `RELEASE` | `0x02` | - | Give up the port lease now. |
| `SET_BAUD` | `0x03` | `baud` uint32 | UART only: ACK at the old rate, then switch. |
| `SET_MODE` | `0x04` | `mode` uint8 | ACK, then restart in receive (0) or transmit (1) mode; the host reconnects. |
| `SET_FREQUENCY` | `0x10` | `mhz` uint16 | Tune the receive LO. |
| `SET_PLL_OFFSET` | `0x11` | `khz` int32 | Fine LO offset applied from the next tune. |
| `SET_GAIN` | `0x12` | `manual` uint8, `index` uint8 | manual=0: hardware AGC; manual=1: fixed PHY gain index. |
| `GET_GAIN` | `0x13` | - | Answered with GAIN. |
| `SET_FILTER` | `0x14` | `code` int8 | Baseband filter code 0..63, or -1 for PHY automatic. |
| `SET_BANDWIDTH` | `0x15` | `mhz` uint8 | Approximate two-sided bandwidth in MHz (13..69); 0 = widest. |
| `GET_FILTER` | `0x16` | - | Answered with FILTER. |
| `SET_DC_MODE` | `0x17` | `mode` uint8 | Spectrum 0 Hz handling: 0 = notch bin 0, 1 = slow tracker. |
| `SET_WORKERS` | `0x18` | `mode` uint8 | Second-core usage for streams. |
| `GET_WORKERS` | `0x19` | - | Answered with WORKERS. |
| `GET_MEMORY` | `0x1A` | - | Answered with MEMORY. |
| `CAPTURE` | `0x20` | `rate` uint8, `format` uint8, `samples` uint32, `repeats` uint32 | Burst capture, repeated; DATA frames then RUN_DONE. |
| `RING_STATS` | `0x21` | `rate` uint8, `duration_ms` uint32 | Gapless continuous run, statistics only; RUN_DONE. duration 0 = until STOP. |
| `RING_CAPTURE` | `0x22` | `rate` uint8, `units` uint8 | Gapless capture of 1..3 consecutive units; RING_DATA then RUN_DONE. |
| `SPECTRUM` | `0x23` | `rate` uint8, `max_hold` uint8, `nfft` uint16, `stats` uint8, `duration_ms` uint32 | On-chip FFT stream; SPECTRUM_FRAME (+STATS) then RUN_DONE. |
| `IQ_STREAM` | `0x24` | `rate` uint8, `bits` uint8, `decimation` uint16, `shift` uint8, `rotate` uint8, `duration_ms` uint32 | Decimated IQ stream from 16 Msps input (rate 2 only), decimation 32..1024; IQ_FRAME then RUN_DONE. shift 255 = automatic. |
| `SCAN` | `0x25` | `from_mhz` uint16, `to_mhz` uint16, `rate` uint8, `averages` uint8, `nfft` uint16, `gain` uint8, `detector` uint8, `sweeps` uint16, `dwell` uint8, `flags` uint8 | Full-band scan; SCAN_SEGMENT frames then RUN_DONE. sweeps 0 = until STOP; gain 255 = AGC; detector 0 mean / 1 peak; flags bit0 flatten, bit1 suppress clock spurs. |
| `STOP` | `0x2F` | - | Ends a running stream or scan (any byte also does). |
| `TX_REGION` | `0x40` | `region` uint8 | Transmit region: 0 ISM 2400-2483.5, 1 HAM 2300-2450, 2 UNRESTRICTED 2210-2790 MHz. |
| `TX_TONE` | `0x41` | `khz` uint32, `atten` uint8 | Carrier on at khz until TX_OFF. atten 0 = full power. |
| `TX_OFF` | `0x42` | - | Carrier off. |
| `TX_BITS` | `0x43` | `center_khz` uint32, `bitrate` uint32, `deviation_hz` uint32, `gap_us` uint32, `count` uint16, `nbits` uint16, `gaussian` uint8, `atten` uint8 | Send nbits packed bits (first = bit 7 of byte 0, 1 = +deviation) count times; followed by the bits. ACK when done (ERR_TIMEOUT: CPU fell behind the bit clock). |
| `TX_BLE` | `0x44` | `gap_us` uint32, `count` uint16, `channel` uint8, `atten` uint8, `adv0` uint8, `adv1` uint8, `adv2` uint8, `adv3` uint8, `adv4` uint8, `adv5` uint8 | BLE ADV_NONCONN_IND, channel 37..39, AdvA adv0..adv5 LSB first; followed by AdvData (<= 31 bytes). ACK when done. |
| `TX_NRF24` | `0x45` | `bitrate` uint32, `gap_us` uint32, `count` uint16, `channel` uint8, `atten` uint8, `addr_len` uint8, `crc_len` uint8, `addr0` uint8, `addr1` uint8, `addr2` uint8, `addr3` uint8, `addr4` uint8 | nRF24 ShockBurst (no ESB), address addr0.. in air order; followed by the payload (<= 32 bytes). ACK when done. |
| `GET_GPIO` | `0x30` | - | Answered with GPIO. |
| `SET_GPIO` | `0x31` | `pin` uint8, `state` uint8 | Drive or float a free GPIO. |

## Replies

| Name | Id | Payload fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ACK` | `0x80` | `error` uint8, `request` uint8 | Result of a request without data. |
| `INFO` | `0x81` | `protocol` uint16, `min_mhz` uint16, `max_mhz` uint16, `gain_max` uint8, `bw_min_mhz` uint8, `bw_max_mhz` uint8, `rates` uint8, `max_samples` uint16, `max_nfft` uint16, `mode` uint8, `region` uint8 | Followed by the JSON version record (variable length). |
| `GAIN` | `0x82` | `manual` uint8, `index` uint8, `max_index` uint8, `forced` uint8 | Current gain state. |
| `FILTER` | `0x83` | `code` int8, `active_i` uint8, `active_q` uint8 | Requested code (-1 automatic) and the two active register codes. |
| `WORKERS` | `0x84` | `mode` uint8, `core1_alive` uint8, `assist_blocks` uint32 | Second-core state. |
| `MEMORY` | `0x85` | `heap_free` uint32, `heap_min_free` uint32, `banks` uint16, `threshold` uint16 | Internal heap and ring geometry. |
| `GPIO` | `0x86` | - | Followed by (pin u8, state u8) pairs for every free pin. |
| `DATA` | `0xA0` | `samples` uint32, `elapsed_us` uint32, `format` uint8, `rate` uint8 | One burst capture; followed by the samples in `format`. |
| `RING_DATA` | `0xA1` | `rate_hz` uint32, `units` uint32, `count0` uint32, `count1` uint32, `count2` uint32 | Units of a ring capture; followed by raw IQ32 words, back to back. |
| `SCAN_SEGMENT` | `0xA6` | `sweep` uint32, `step` uint16, `steps` uint16, `lo_mhz` uint16, `bins` uint16, `start_hz` uint32, `bin_millihz` uint32, `gain` uint8, `ffts` uint8, `db_step` uint8, `spurs` uint8, `elapsed_us` uint32 | One scan step; followed by `bins` 0.5 dB codes, ascending frequency. |
| `RUN_DONE` | `0xA5` | `status` uint8, `stopped_by_host` uint8, `error` uint8, `detail` uint32, `units` uint32, `late_max` uint32, `pairs` uint64, `elapsed_us` uint64, `work_max` uint32, `frames` uint32, `drops` uint32, `abandoned` uint32, `ffts` uint32, `lost_pairs` uint32 | Ends every CAPTURE / RING_* / SPECTRUM / IQ_STREAM / SCAN request. |

## Stream records (emitted by the library, `esp_sdr_record.h`)

| Name | Id | Payload fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SPECTRUM_FRAME` | `0xA2` | `frame` uint32, `pair_index` uint64, `pairs` uint32, `ffts` uint16, `flags` uint8, `gain` uint8, `drops` uint16, `nfft_log2` uint8, `db_step` uint8 | Followed by 1 << nfft_log2 bin codes (dB * db_step, natural order). |
| `IQ_FRAME` | `0xA3` | `frame` uint32, `sample_index` uint64, `samples` uint16, `bits` uint8, `flags` uint8, `decimation` uint16, `gain` uint8, `shift` uint8 | Followed by `samples` IQ pairs of `bits` bits each component. |
| `STATS` | `0xA4` | `core0_permille` uint16, `core1_permille` uint16, `coverage_permille` uint16, `mode` uint16, `heap_free` uint32, `heap_largest` uint32, `abandoned` uint32, `drops` uint32, `late_max` uint16, `queue_permille` uint16, `ffts_per_s` uint32 | Live spectrum statistics, about four per second. |

Spectrum bins are 0.5 dB codes (`db_step` codes per dB) relative to full scale of
the int16 FFT, in FFT order: bin k is k * fs / N above the LO for k < N/2, and
the upper half holds the negative frequencies (apply an fftshift to display). `flags`: bit 0 max-hold,
bit 1 some FFT work was abandoned, bit 2 frames were dropped before this one.
IQ frame `flags`: bit 0 gap before this frame, bit 1 frames dropped before it.
